reuse.why: Builds on the existing refuseIfBankAccountLinked wrapper, splits link.assertBankAccountNotLinked into a reusable findBankAccountHolders query, and extracts the unlink field reset so both unlinkAccount and the takeover use it.

duplication.why: The holder query and the unlink reset each stay in one place; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The holder lookup stays in accounts/link.ts beside the existing link checks, and the flag is handled once in the handler wrapper that every link request goes through.

scope.why: Only the flag, the extracted helpers and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clean and central; the wrapper keeps the name refuseIfBankAccountLinked although it now also performs the takeover, which is slightly misleading.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers go through refuseIfBankAccountLinked; the takeover reuses the unlink reset via clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink update is moved into clearAccountBankLink and the query into findBankAccountHolders, not copied.
